instruction.text: Spell the word correctly by adding the suffix to the word ending in -e.

hint.text: When adding suffixes that start with a vowel (such as -ing) to words ending in -e, drop the -e. When adding suffixes that start with a consonant (such as -less) to words ending in -e, keep the -e. There are sometimes exceptions to this rule.
This is an example of an exception to the rule. Even though the suffix begins with a vowel, we do not drop the -e from the root word.

instruction.text: Choose the correct spelling of the word to complete the sentence.

instruction.text: Choose the correct spelling of the word to complete the sentence.

atoms.b: ((++Surely Surly)) this is the hottest day of the year.

instruction.text: Choose the correct spelling of the word to complete the sentence.
